body.raw: {"nodeType":"document","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"paragraph","content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"SDK stands for software development kit.","marks":[],"data":{}}],"data":{}},{"nodeType":"paragraph","content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"But first, we need to take a step back and talk about APIs.","marks":[],"data":{}}],"data":{}},{"nodeType":"paragraph","content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"So what’s an API? An API (application programming interface) is a piece of code that allows two apps to communicate with each other.","marks":[],"data":{}}],"data":{}},{"nodeType":"paragraph","content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"You can see an SDK as a toolbox that unites different APIs and libraries. Mobile app SDKs usually contain multiple APIs that work together.","marks":[],"data":{}}],"data":{}},{"nodeType":"paragraph","content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"In other words: You add an SDK to your app by adding a few lines of code. Your app can now communicate to 3rd-party services via APIs.","marks":[],"data":{}}],"data":{}},{"nodeType":"paragraph","content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"All successful mobile apps have integrated a wide range of SDKs.","marks":[],"data":{}}],"data":{}}]}

{"nodeType":"document","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"paragraph","content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"SDKs empower mobile apps. They enable sophisticated analytics, e.g., ","marks":[],"data":{}},{"nodeType":"hyperlink","content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"heatmaps","marks":[],"data":{}}],"data":{"uri":"https://uxcam.com/glossary/heatmap"}},{"nodeType":"text","value":", or allow your app to send push notifications.","marks":[],"data":{}}],"data":{}},{"nodeType":"paragraph","content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"In doing so, you get more information about the performance of your app. If your app can communicate with 3rd-party services, you can reach a bigger audience and join a network that is full of opportunities.","marks":[],"data":{}}],"data":{}}]}

{"nodeType":"document","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"paragraph","content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"A simple example of a mobile app SDK is the option to log into an app via a Facebook account. The app communicates with Facebook to confirm the data transmission.","marks":[],"data":{}}],"data":{}},{"nodeType":"paragraph","content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"A more complex example is analytics SDKs. For example, the UXCam SDK captures all user interactions of an app to provide customers with actionable UX insights.","marks":[],"data":{}}],"data":{}},{"nodeType":"paragraph","content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"For a list of essential SDK vendors, download our SDK guide ","marks":[],"data":{}},{"nodeType":"hyperlink","content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"here","marks":[],"data":{}}],"data":{"uri":"https://resources.uxcam.com/e-books/complete-sdk-guide-2021"}},{"nodeType":"text","value":".","marks":[],"data":{}}],"data":{}}]}
